questions.question: Which of the following limits the highest frequency signal that can be accurately displayed on a digital oscilloscope?

choices.A: Sampling rate of the analog-to-digital converter

questions.answer: Sampling rate of the analog-to-digital converter

questions.question: Which of the following parameters does a spectrum analyzer display on the vertical and horizontal axes?
questions.answer: Signal amplitude and frequency

questions.question: Which of the following test instruments is used to display spurious signals and/or intermodulation distortion products generated by an SSB transmitter?
questions.answer: Spectrum analyzer

questions.question: How is compensation of an oscilloscope probe performed?

choices.A: A square wave is displayed, and the probe is adjusted until the horizontal portions of the displayed wave are as nearly flat as possible
choices.B: A high frequency sine wave is displayed, and the probe is adjusted for maximum amplitude
choices.C: A frequency standard is displayed, and the probe is adjusted until the deflection time is accurate
choices.D: A DC voltage standard is displayed, and the probe is adjusted until the displayed voltage is accurate

questions.answer: A square wave is displayed, and the probe is adjusted until the horizontal portions of the displayed wave are as nearly flat as possible

questions.question: What is the purpose of using a prescaler with a frequency counter?

choices.A: Amplify low-level signals for more accurate counting
choices.B: Multiply a higher frequency signal so a low-frequency counter can display the operating frequency
choices.C: Prevent oscillation in a low-frequency counter circuit
choices.D: Reduce the signal frequency to within the counter's operating range

questions.answer: Reduce the signal frequency to within the counter's operating range

questions.question: What is the effect of aliasing on a digital oscilloscope when displaying a waveform?

choices.A: A false, jittery low-frequency version of the waveform is displayed
choices.B: The waveform DC offset will be inaccurate
choices.C: Calibration of the vertical scale is no longer valid
choices.D: Excessive blanking occurs, which prevents display of the waveform

questions.answer: A false, jittery low-frequency version of the waveform is displayed

questions.question: Which of the following is an advantage of using an antenna analyzer compared to an SWR bridge?

choices.A: Antenna analyzers automatically tune your antenna for resonance
choices.B: Antenna analyzers compute SWR and impedance automatically
choices.C: Antenna analyzers display a time-varying representation of the modulation envelope

questions.answer: Antenna analyzers compute SWR and impedance automatically

questions.question: Which of the following is used to measure SWR?
questions.answer: All these choices are correct

questions.question: Which of the following is good practice when using an oscilloscope probe?

choices.A: Minimize the length of the probe's ground connection
choices.B: Never use a high-impedance probe to measure a low-impedance circuit
choices.C: Never use a DC-coupled probe to measure an AC circuit

questions.answer: Minimize the length of the probe's ground connection

questions.question: Which trigger mode is most effective when using an oscilloscope to measure a linear power supply’s output ripple?
questions.answer: Line

questions.question: Which of the following can be measured with an antenna analyzer?

choices.C: Resonant frequency of a tuned circuit

questions.answer: All these choices are correct

questions.question: Which of the following factors most affects the accuracy of a frequency counter?
questions.answer: Time base accuracy

questions.question: What is the significance of voltmeter sensitivity expressed in ohms per volt?

choices.A: The full scale reading of the voltmeter multiplied by its ohms per volt rating is the input impedance of the voltmeter
choices.B: The reading in volts multiplied by the ohms per volt rating will determine the power drawn by the device under test
choices.C: The reading in ohms divided by the ohms per volt rating will determine the voltage applied to the circuit
choices.D: The full scale reading in amps divided by ohms per volt rating will determine the size of shunt needed

questions.answer: The full scale reading of the voltmeter multiplied by its ohms per volt rating is the input impedance of the voltmeter

questions.question: Which S parameter is equivalent to forward gain?
Which S parameter represents input port return loss or reflection coefficient (equivalent to VSWR)?
What three test loads are used to calibrate an RF vector network analyzer?

choices.B: Short circuit, open circuit, and 50 ohms
choices.C: Short circuit, open circuit, and resonant circuit
choices.D: 50 ohms through 1/8 wavelength, 1/4 wavelength, and 1/2 wavelength of coaxial cable

questions.answer: Short circuit, open circuit, and 50 ohms

questions.question: How much power is being absorbed by the load when a directional power meter connected between a transmitter and a terminating load reads 100 watts forward power and 25 watts reflected power?
questions.answer: 75 watts

questions.question: What do the subscripts of S parameters represent?

choices.A: The port or ports at which measurements are made

questions.answer: The port or ports at which measurements are made

questions.question: Which of the following can be used to determine the Q of a series-tuned circuit?

choices.A: The ratio of inductive reactance to capacitive reactance
choices.C: The bandwidth of the circuit's frequency response
choices.D: The resonant frequency of the circuit

questions.answer: The bandwidth of the circuit's frequency response

questions.question: Which of the following can be measured by a two-port vector network analyzer?
questions.answer: Filter frequency response

questions.question: Which of the following methods measures intermodulation distortion in an SSB transmitter?

choices.A: Modulate the transmitter using two RF signals having non-harmonically related frequencies and observe the RF output with a spectrum analyzer
choices.B: Modulate the transmitter using two AF signals having non-harmonically related frequencies and observe the RF output with a spectrum analyzer
choices.C: Modulate the transmitter using two AF signals having harmonically related frequencies and observe the RF output with a peak reading wattmeter
choices.D: Modulate the transmitter using two RF signals having harmonically related frequencies and observe the RF output with a logic analyzer

questions.answer: Modulate the transmitter using two AF signals having non-harmonically related frequencies and observe the RF output with a spectrum analyzer

questions.question: Which of the following can be measured with a vector network analyzer?
questions.answer: All these choices are correct
